pull.title: sql: treat validation errors as permanent once the upgrade is finalized
pull.body:
See #101450, which reverted #101200: descriptors can fail validation transiently while the cluster version gate is being crossed.

This treats descriptor validation errors as permanent again once the cluster version is finalized; until then the schema changer keeps retrying them, so jobs that run during an upgrade still succeed on retry.

Release note: None

commit.message:

reviews.body: Good middle ground: permanent once the upgrade is done, still retried while it runs.
